caption:
So what did happen on 12 August 2026? (A total solar eclipse, seen from Spain, Iceland and Greenland. Gravity stayed on.)
Not a paper: NASA statement to Snopes (rating False) and Newsweek, Jan and Aug 2026. Eclipse times: NASA.

The 'Project Anchor' posts said Earth would lose gravity for 7 seconds at 14:33 UTC on 12 August 2026, citing a leaked '$89 billion NASA document' that no one has ever produced. Gravity is a property of mass; it has no off switch. NASA and fact-checkers debunked it. The real event that day was a total solar eclipse, totality on the ground from 16:58 to 18:34 UTC, up to 2 min 18 s, the first on mainland Europe since 1999. The hoax's time was two hours before it even began. Images are generated illustrations.

#debunk #physics #gravity #eclipse #science
